name: Cooperative AI Foundation Research Grants (incl. Early-Career Track)
amount: Min GBP 10,000; early-career track max GBP 100,000 (up to 12 months); past grants GBP 10k-385k (median ~GBP 150k); overhead max 10% of direct costs
duration: Up to 12 months (early-career track); up to 2 years (standard)
eligibility: Researchers anywhere; early-career track for postdocs/junior researchers typically within 2-3 years of PhD; projects in cooperative AI research areas
eligibility_note: Grants page: 'applicants can be located anywhere in the world'; affiliation helpful but not required.
how_to_apply_tip: Early-career track fits a 0-3 yr postdoc exactly; read their research-area list and sign up to the newsletter, since rounds open with a pre-proposal stage.
deadline_quote: Our first grant deadline for 2025 has passed and we are no longer accepting applications. ... To stay informed about future opportunities, please sign up for our newsletter below or revisit this page for updates.
verdict_reason: Official page sets no nationality, institution, age or gender restriction; affiliation not required; early-career track expects applicants within 2-3 years of PhD, which a <2-year PhD meets. No round is currently open, so this applies to the next call's terms if unchanged.
eligibility_quote: You can be located anywhere in the world. ... An affiliation can, in many cases, strengthen your proposal, but is not required. ... We expect most early-career applicants to apply within 2-3 years of completing their PhD.

name: IPAM Long Program Participation – Artificial Intelligence in Materials Science (Fall 2027)
funder: Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics (IPAM), UCLA (NSF)
amount: Financial support (housing and travel) for extended participation; amount not stated
eligibility: Researchers at all career stages; early-career participants encouraged
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated on the IPAM page.
how_to_apply_tip: Watch the program page and apply as soon as the form opens; stress your ML for scientific modeling work.
deadline_quote: Applications will be accepted through Friday, April 16, 2027, but offers may be made at any time, up to one year before the start date. Applications received after the deadline will still be considered if there is space available.
verdict_reason: Funding is open to researchers at all career levels in this area. The page has no nationality, age or institution restriction, and your AI/ML background fits the program theme.
eligibility_quote: We typically offer support to recent PhDs, graduate students, and researchers in the early stages of their career; however, mathematicians and scientists at all levels who are interested in this area are encouraged to apply for funding.

name: IVADO Postdoctoral Research Funding Program 2027
funder: IVADO (Institut de valorisation des données), Québec
amount: CAD 80,000 per year salary (incl. benefits)
eligibility: PhD earned < 3 years before funding start; supervisor = regular faculty at UdeM, Polytechnique, HEC Montréal, Laval or McGill (IVADO-affiliated); full-time research in Québec
eligibility_note: Open to national and international researchers; no citizenship requirement; ODA-country applicants may claim relocation costs.
deadline_quote: Application deadline: 11:59 PM Eastern Time on November 22, 2026
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a supervisor at one of the 5 partner universities now (each supervisor can back only ONE application) and make sure reference letters arrive by the same 22 Nov deadline.
verdict_reason: Your PhD (after Nov 2024) is well within the <3-year window, the call is open to international applicants and sets no age, gender or institution-type bar. You would need leave from (or to leave) BIC, because the award funds full-time research and you must live in Québec.
eligibility_quote: "Have earned their doctorate less than three years prior to the beginning of the IVADO funding"; "Applications from candidates whose primary doctoral affiliation is outside Quebec are strongly encouraged."; "The postdoctoral researcher must remain in Quebec for the entire duration of the funding period."; "The funding is provided solely for full-time research activity."

name: Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851 – Research Fellowship 2027
funder: Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851
amount: Full payroll cost/stipend at host-equivalent level + expense allowance of GBP 10,000 per year
eligibility: PhD (or final stage); normally <=2.5 years postdoctoral experience by 31 Jan 2027; physical/biological sciences, maths, applied science or any branch of engineering; normally held at an approved UK institution different from PhD institution
eligibility_note: Terms and Conditions 2027 contain no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: Get a UK host acceptance letter and two referees (one normally from a UK institution, neither from the host) well before 20 Jan 2027; host universities often have earlier internal deadlines (e.g. Nov 2026).
deadline_quote: "Completed applications must be submitted by 20 January 2027 by 12 noon GMT."
verdict_reason: Your PhD is under 2 years old, inside the 2.5-year early-career limit, engineering/applied science covers AI and robotics, and the terms set no nationality, age or home-institution restriction. You would need full-time release (the fellowship requires your whole working time for research).
eligibility_quote: "Candidates should hold a PhD or be in the final stages of their PhD studies ... those with more than 2.5 years postdoctoral research experience (discounting career breaks) by 31 January in the year of award (31 January 2027) will only be considered in exceptional circumstances" / "A Fellowship will normally be held at a UK Institution approved by the Commissioners; the research should be carried out at a different Institution from the one where the candidate's PhD research was undertaken."

name: TWAS-FAPESP Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme for Developing Countries
amount: FAPESP postdoctoral (PD) fellowship monthly rate (FAPESP Scholarship Values Table) plus an Installation Grant. Up to 20 fellowships.
eligibility: PhD within the last 7 years in natural, applied or social sciences (incl. engineering and mathematical sciences); no age limit; host in São Paulo State
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of 'all developing countries' (TWAS list includes Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: Supervisors register expressions of interest by 1 Nov 2026 and the list is published 1 Dec 2026; pick a CS/engineering supervisor from that list, who submits the full proposal by 1 Apr 2027.
deadline_quote: Deadline for submission of proposals: 01/04/2027 (expression-of-interest deadline for supervisors 01/11/2026; list of potential supervisors announced 01/12/2026)
verdict_reason: Pakistan is on the TWAS developing-countries list, the PhD is within 7 years, there is no age limit and engineering is covered. The candidate must not hold a Brazilian or developed-country residence visa. This is a 12-month, full-stipend postdoc that requires leave, which is a format the profile does not want.
eligibility_quote: a) Be a permanent resident and natural-born of one of the developing countries, listed in https://twas.org/subset/all-developing-countries; b) Not have a temporary or permanent residence visa in Brazil or in any developed country; ... d) Hold a doctorate in a natural, applied or social sciences area; e) Apply for the Scholarship within seven (07) years after obtaining the doctorate

name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027 – European Postdoctoral Fellowships (HORIZON-MSCA-2027-PF-01-01)
funder: European Commission / European Research Executive Agency (REA)
amount: Unit-cost funding per MSCA Work Programme 2026-2027: living allowance, mobility allowance, family/special-needs allowances where applicable, plus research, training, networking and management costs (see website). Call 2026 budget EUR 399.05 million
duration: 12-24 months (European PF), plus optional non-academic placement
eligibility: PhD holder with max. 8 years research experience since PhD; must move to host in an EU Member State/Associated Country where you have not resided >12 months in the 36 months before the deadline; any nationality
eligibility_note: European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality (official topic text).
how_to_apply_tip: Pick a supervisor at an EU host (e.g. a robotics/AI lab in Spain, Portugal, Italy, Czechia or Poland) by early 2027 and draft Part B with the host's EU office; many universities run internal pre-screening months before the September deadline.
deadline_quote: EU Funding & Tenders Portal topic HORIZON-MSCA-2027-PF-01-01 'MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027': status 'Forthcoming', planned opening date 7 April 2027, deadline date 8 September 2027 (portal data, Brussels time).
verdict_reason: You are a non-EU national with a PhD of under 2 years (well under the 8-year cap) who has lived in Pakistan, so the nationality, career-stage and mobility rules are all met for a European Postdoctoral Fellowship; no age, gender or home-institution-type rule applies. You would need leave from BIC because the fellowship is an employment contract at the European host.
eligibility_quote: "European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality who wish to engage in R&I projects by either coming to Europe from any country in the world or moving within Europe. The standard duration of these fellowships must be between 12 and 24 months." / "must have a maximum of eight years experience in research, from the date of the award of their PhD degree" / "they must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the beneficiary ... for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the call deadline."

name: DAAD AInet Fellowship (Postdoctoral Networking Tour in AI)
amount: Virtual networking week + one-week travel stipend to Germany; access to exclusive 1-3 month short-term research funding
duration: 1 week trip (+ optional 1-3 month research stay)
eligibility: International early-career AI researchers; PhD ≤5 years; not affiliated with a German institution in the last 2 years
eligibility_note: Open to international researchers; no nationality restriction stated.
how_to_apply_tip: Awarded twice a year on a changing AI theme (Nov 2026 was 'Reliable AI'). Watch the page for the next theme and apply when it matches robotics or embodied AI.
deadline_quote: The DAAD AInet Fellowship is awarded twice a year ... The Virtual Networking Week will take place from November 2 - 6, 2026. All applicants have received their results.
verdict_reason: Your PhD is under 5 years old, your record is strong (h-index 18), and you have no German affiliation. This is a networking fellowship that leads to a short-stay grant, not a salaried postdoc.
eligibility_quote: Candidates should have: a very strong scientific track record ... obtained a PhD/doctorate no longer than 5 years ago ... not been affiliated with a German institution during the last two years.

name: ETH AI Center Postdoctoral Fellowships
amount: 100% full-time employment contract at standard ETH Zurich salary rates (programme covers up to 50%, host labs match)
eligibility: Doctorate in hand or completed at least 3 months before start; AI research with ETH AI Center faculty
eligibility_note: Official FAQ states no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: The 2027 round closed on 27 Oct 2026. For the 2028 round, expect the portal to open mid-September 2027, and line up two referees and matching ETH AI Center faculty in advance.
deadline_quote: Applications for the 2027 doctoral and postdoctoral fellowships will open from Tuesday, September 15, 2026 until 16:00 CET on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
verdict_reason: You hold a PhD, and the official FAQ sets no upper limit on time since PhD and no nationality, age or institution restriction. The 2027 round closed on 27 Oct 2026, so the next chance is the 2028 round.
eligibility_quote: Candidates must hold a doctorate (PhD) or will complete their doctorate at least 3 months before the beginning of the fellowship.

name: ISTA-Fellow International Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
amount: Min. EUR 73,500 gross per year + project budget
eligibility: PhD held at call deadline or by 15/06/2027; host group at ISTA (all except astronomy, incl. Data & Computer Science); not already employed at ISTA
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated in Guide for Applicants; ISTA International Office provides visa support.
how_to_apply_tip: The 2026 call closed on 8 Sep 2026. Contact an ISTA computer science or robotics-adjacent group now so your project fits the host's expertise for the 2027 call.
deadline_quote: The closing date for the Call for Proposals is 8th September, 2026 (14:00 CEST)
verdict_reason: You hold a PhD and have never worked at ISTA. The official guide sets no nationality, age, institution or time-since-PhD limit. Wait for the 2027 call.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent) on the date of the call deadline or anticipate completing their PhD degree before the start of their fellowship (no later than 15/06/2027). ... Researchers already employed at ISTA before 01/09/2026 are not eligible to apply.

name: RGC Junior Research Fellow Scheme (JRFS, formerly Postdoctoral Fellowship Scheme PDFS)
amount: Annual stipend about HK$430,000 (incl. ~HK$13,600 travel allowance); HK$140,000/yr research support if advanced to Asst Prof/RAP
eligibility: PhD on or after 1 Jan 2023; legal right to work in Hong Kong during fellowship; nominated by a UGC-funded university (max 15 nominees each)
eligibility_note: Scheme explicitly targets 'local and non-local postdoctoral researchers'; no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: You need a UGC-funded university (e.g. HKUST, CUHK, PolyU) to nominate you; universities run internal rounds around July-September, so line up a host by mid-2027 for the 2028/29 exercise.
deadline_quote: The nomination deadline for the JRFS (2027/28) is 30 October 2026 (Friday). Nominations must be submitted to the UGC Secretariat by 5:00 p.m. on that day.
verdict_reason: Your PhD (after Nov 2024) is within the 'on or after 1 January 2023' window, and there is no nationality, age or home-institution condition; you would obtain HK work rights through the host university. The 2027/28 round closed yesterday, so aim for the next exercise.
eligibility_quote: To qualify for the fellowship, the JRFS nominee must: obtain a legal right to work and reside in Hong Kong during the fellowship period; have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification on or after 1 January 2023 ... and be supported by a UGC-funded university at which he / she wishes to hold the fellowship.

name: Royal Society Newton International Fellowships
funder: The Royal Society and the British Academy
amount: Up to GBP 280,000 over two years
eligibility: PhD; <=5 years active full-time postdoctoral experience; based outside the UK; not a UK citizen; natural sciences/engineering remit; UK host
eligibility_note: Open to non-UK citizens based outside the UK.
how_to_apply_tip: Line up a UK host (e.g. a robotics group at Bristol, Edinburgh, Oxford, Imperial) before the next round opens (2026 round opened mid-January); the host co-signs the application.

verdict_reason: You are a non-UK citizen based outside the UK, with a PhD under 2 years (inside the 5-year postdoctoral-experience limit), working in engineering within the Royal Society's remit; no age, gender or institution-type rule applies.
eligibility_quote: "You have a PhD, or will have successfully defended your doctoral thesis before the closing date for applications" / "You have no more than five years of active full-time postdoctoral experience post-PhD at the time of application" / "You are based outside the UK" / "You do not hold UK citizenship"

name: COMSTECH-TWAS Programme for Young Scientists in OIC (Joint Research Grants)
amount: Max USD 15,000
eligibility: OIC nationals with PhD, early-career, generally under 40, at a university/research institution in an OIC country; fields include IT and computer sciences

eligibility: Students and early-career scientists with an accepted paper; no previous ISCA grant

verdict_reason: Grants target students and early-career scientists ('early career' undefined); the low-income-country exception does not clearly cover Pakistan (lower-middle income). Nationality is fine.
eligibility_quote: "ISCA financially supports students and early career scientists"; "researchers in special situations like unemployment or coming from low income-level countries" may apply exceptionally; "Applicants from all countries are eligible."
ask_funder: Does ISCA consider a faculty member (Associate Professor) awarded the PhD in 2025 an 'early career scientist' eligible for an ISCA travel grant?

amount: Typically USD 600 (intra-continental) or USD 1,200 (inter-continental), reimbursed after in-person attendance
eligibility: IEEE CIS members above student grade from developing countries presenting an accepted paper in person at a CIS-sponsored conference (separate student and industry early-career tracks)

name: IBS Young Scientist Fellowship (YSF) 2027
amount: Annual fund KRW 180-300 million (theory/experimental) incl. salary KRW 60-70 million
eligibility: Within 7 years of PhD (on/after 1 Jan 2019) or under 40 with PhD; must be hosted by one of the listed hiring IBS Centers (basic science)
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction in the 2027 call; applicants abroad can be interviewed by video.

verdict_reason: You meet the PhD rule (PhD after 2019), but YSF posts are only in the listed basic-science Centers (mathematics, physics, chemistry, life sciences), none of which is AI or robotics, so your proposal must fit one of them.
eligibility_quote: YSF - Within seven years of obtaining a Ph.D. (obtained no earlier than 1 January 2019) or under the age of 40 with a Ph.D. (born no earlier than 1 January 1986)

name: ETH Zurich Postdoctoral Fellowships (ETH Fellows)
amount: 100% ETH-standard salary + CHF 12,000 per year research expenses
eligibility: PhD max. 2 years before submission deadline; ≥1 peer-reviewed journal paper; joint application with ETH professor (mentor); mobility rules
eligibility_note: No nationality requirement; ineligible if >12 months in Switzerland in the last 3 years or PhD from ETH/UZH.
how_to_apply_tip: Find an ETH professor (e.g. in D-MAVT robotics or D-INFK) you have NOT collaborated with before. Each professor may submit only one application per round, and two reference letters must reach ethfellows@sl.ethz.ch 10 days before the deadline.
deadline_quote: There are two ETH Fellowship calls per year. Submission deadlines are 1 March and 1 September, 17:00 Swiss local time.
verdict_reason: Nationality and mobility rules do not exclude you, but your PhD defence must be no more than 2 years before the deadline. For 1 Mar 2027 that means a defence on or after 1 Mar 2025. If you defended between Nov 2024 and Feb 2025, you are already too late.
eligibility_quote: Applicants with the doctorate (PhD) must have obtained it a maximum of two years prior to the submission deadline. The decisive date is the date of the examination or defense/viva voce. ... Applicants who resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Switzerland for more than twelve months in the three years immediately before the submission deadline are ineligible.

eligibility_quote: Foreign nationals may apply only if "currently in a Canadian doctoral or health professional program, have completed one at a Canadian institution, or are doing postdoctoral research at a Canadian institution"; applicants must "not hold or be on leave from a tenure-track or tenured faculty position."

name: HEC Post-Doctoral Fellowship Program (Phase III)
amount: Living allowance (reported ~USD 1,600/month, varies by host country) + one-time health insurance, airfare and research/bench costs – see Financial Support page
eligibility: Age <= 45; local HEC-attested PhD, or foreign PhD + 5 years work in Pakistan; regular employee of HEC-recognized HEI or PCST-recognized R&D org; no previous postdoc (>3 months); placement at QS top-200 university
eligibility_note: Only for Pakistani regular employees of Pakistani HEIs/R&D orgs; foreign-PhD holders need 5 years post-PhD service in Pakistan (local-PhD holders do not)
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a placement letter from a QS top-200 supervisor (dated within 6 months) and a 9-month leave NOC before the portal (pdfp.hec.gov.pk) opens.
deadline_quote: Portal "will be opened for a specific duration according to Pakistan Standard Time (PST) and the last date will not be extended in any case." The official programme page gives no current batch dates.
verdict_reason: Applicants must be regular employees of an HEC-recognised university or degree-awarding institution, and BIC is a private TNE college, not a DAI. A foreign PhD also needs 5 years of recognised work in Pakistan after the PhD. The last batch date (2025-10-30) appears only in secondary sources, not on HEC's pages.
eligibility_quote: Be a regular employee of public/private sector HEC recognized university/degree awarding institution or public sector R&D organization (recognized by Pakistan Council of Science & Technology). | Possess five years' recognized work experience in Pakistan after completion of foreign Ph.D. | Not be more than 45 years of age on the date mentioned in the advertisement.
